Question:
Calculate the overall average first round and average last round of races missed by Formula 1 drivers across all years. Include only drivers who missed fewer than three races in a given year and who switched teams between their appearances immediately before and after their hiatus (i.e., the constructor ID for the race right before their first missed race must be different from the constructor ID for the race right after their last missed race in that year). Do not group results by year; return just the overall averages across the entire dataset.

SQL:
WITH ordered_drives AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    driver_id,
    constructor_id,
    drive_id,
    first_round,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY drive_id) as drive_order
  FROM drives
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    o1.year,
    o1.driver_id,
    o1.constructor_id as prev_constructor,
    o1.first_round as prev_round,
    o2.constructor_id as next_constructor,
    o2.first_round as next_round,
    o2.first_round - o1.first_round - 1 as missed_count,
    o1.first_round + 1 as first_missed_round,
    o2.first_round - 1 as last_missed_round
  FROM ordered_drives o1
  JOIN ordered_drives o2 ON o1.year = o2.year AND o1.driver_id = o2.driver_id AND o1.drive_order + 1 = o2.drive_order
  WHERE o2.first_round - o1.first_round > 1
),
driver_year_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    driver_id,
    SUM(missed_count) as total_missed,
    MIN(first_missed_round) as first_missed_round,
    MAX(last_missed_round) as last_missed_round,
    MIN(prev_constructor) as first_constructor,
    MAX(next_constructor) as last_constructor
  FROM gaps
  GROUP BY year, driver_id
  HAVING SUM(missed_count) < 3
)
SELECT 
  AVG(first_missed_round) as avg_first_missed_round,
  AVG(last_missed_round) as avg_last_missed_round
FROM driver_year_summary
WHERE first_constructor != last_constructor

WITH race_counts AS (
  SELECT year, COUNT(*) as total_races
  FROM races
  GROUP BY year
),
driver_participation AS (
  SELECT 
    d.driver_id,
    d.year,
    MIN(d.first_round) as first_participation_round,
    MAX(d.last_round) as last_participation_round
  FROM drives d
  GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.year
),
driver_missed AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.driver_id,
    dp.year,
    dp.first_participation_round,
    dp.last_participation_round,
    rc.total_races,
    rc.total_races - (dp.last_participation_round - dp.first_participation_round + 1) as races_missed
  FROM driver_participation dp
  JOIN race_counts rc ON dp.year = rc.year
  WHERE rc.total_races - (dp.last_participation_round - dp.first_participation_round + 1) < 3
)
SELECT * FROM driver_missed
WHERE races_missed > 0
ORDER BY year, driver_id, races_missed

WITH driver_year_stats AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, COUNT(*) as drive_count
    FROM drives
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING drive_count >= 2
),
driver_drives_ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        d.year,
        d.driver_id,
        d.constructor_id,
        d.first_round,
        d.last_round,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.year, d.driver_id ORDER BY d.first_round) as drive_order,
        LAG(d.constructor_id) OVER (PARTITION BY d.year, d.driver_id ORDER BY d.first_round) as prev_constructor
    FROM drives d
    JOIN driver_year_stats dy ON d.year = dy.year AND d.driver_id = dy.driver_id
),
gap_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        constructor_id,
        first_round,
        last_round,
        drive_order,
        prev_constructor,
        first_round - LAG(last_round) OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY drive_order) as gap_size
    FROM driver_drives_ordered
    WHERE prev_constructor IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT * FROM gap_analysis WHERE gap_size > 0 ORDER BY year, driver_id, drive_order LIMIT 50
